ui.q1: How do I view previous Claude Code sessions?
ui.a1: For local sessions, look under ~/.claude/projects/ or your custom configuration directory. Import a saved JSONL file to read the supported records it contains.
ui.q2: Is my session file uploaded anywhere?
ui.a2: Session files are parsed and rendered locally in your browser. The hosted site automatically loads Microsoft Clarity to record page interactions. Offline copies do not load analytics.
ui.a3: This Claude Code JSONL viewer supports Markdown rendering for user and assistant messages, extended thinking blocks, tool call parameters and results, images, token usage and cost stats — with an interface in 10 languages.
ui.a4: JSON Lines — one independent JSON object per line. Claude Code logs every message, tool call and metadata entry as a line.
ui.a5: Yes, it is free and open-source. No sign-up required.
